sentences.text: 1. This is an application seeking early hearing and quashing of the FIR No. 224/2024 dated 31.05.2024 under Section 420/120B of IPC registered at PS Special Cell in view of the reply of the respondent No. 3 supporting the petitioner.
2. The FIR has been registered by the respondent No. 2 purportedly for and on behalf of the respondent No. 3.
3. For the said reasons, I deem it proper that the respondent No. 2 be served.

4. The matter is preponed from 17.12.2024 to 02.12.2024 and notice be served to the respondent No.
